description: Local File Inclusion / path traversal → read files, sometimes RCE. Load when a param names a file/path/template/page: ?file=, ?page=, ?template=, ?download=, ?lang=, or path segments. Signals: filenames in params, "include", download endpoints, `../` filtered, `.php?page=`.
